summary: Your twenty-second Sunday review and the end of Module 13. You answer 9 questions on settings, secrets, workflows, gates and badges with a confidence number, write the module retrospective (including what you did not run), extend your glossary, count how hard your system is to start, tag week 22 and plan week 23 (open-weight models and serving them).

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Write the Module 13 retrospective, 2 lines for each of 5 questions
Write exactly what you ran this module and what you could not run
Glossary: add 8 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Error log: group this week's entries into 3 themes and fix the top one
Run git tag week-22, then plan week 23 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 3 to 5 applications
Play the Module 13 Mix-up game to the end and see your score
